speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) to date, how many single parents have successfully applied for a home under the Assistance Scheme for Second-Timers (Divorced/Widowed Parents) (ASSIST); (b) for cases where applicants had financial difficulties, how many were reviewed by HDB and what were the outcomes of the review; and (c) are there sufficient flats and temporary housing to meet the demand by single parents.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Most needed help with paying the resale levy.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Of the remaining applicants, some wanted to buy a flat beyond their means.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In such circumstances, HDB will advise them to buy a flat within their budget instead, while others were advised to defer the flat purchase until they were financially ready.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Those who have booked BTO or uncompleted SBF flats may also apply to rent a flat under the Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: HDB reviews its policies and rental flat supply regularly to ensure that there are sufficient rental flats for such families.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: With regard to the resale levy, I have been seeing a substantial number of residents persistently asking for help with the resale levy incorporated into their loans.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: There is an increasing risk of them being unable to pay the resale levy in full before purchasing the flat.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: What other plans does HDB have to help because these requests for resale levy increase over time?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: For those cases where, clearly, even with incorporation of the resale levy, they will find it unaffordable, then I think the right thing to do would be to give them financial counselling and advise them to defer the purchase to a later date.
